Every pirate on this ship works hard, except one.
Meet Barnaby, the laziest pirate on the seven seas.
While the crew scrubs the deck, he naps.
While they climb the ropes, he naps.
Even when the cannon fires, he just rolls over.
The whole crew laughs at him, every single day.
But one night, a giant storm hits.
The crew fights the waves for hours, until every last one of them falls asleep.
Everyone except Barnaby, because he slept all day.
So he is the only one awake to see the rocks.
He grabs the wheel, and turns the ship just in time.
The next morning, the captain hands him the treasure.
And Barnaby? He falls asleep right on top of it.
